espn-604593.headline: Jake White starts by guarding a streak from 1994
beats: Japan have not beaten Fiji in consecutive Tests since May 1994. They won the Pacific Nations Cup final 20–15 on this ground on 19 September, and Fiji have since hired Jake White, who won the 2007 World Cup with South Africa.

White's first team has four uncapped players, two of them starting. Fiji's rugby boss says the pragmatic South African will not kick the flair out of them. One win in five this year suggests the flair could use some company.
Japan come into the JRFU's 100th anniversary match on three straight wins. Win and Fiji go back above them; lose and Fiji drop below Wales, who beat them 39–24 in July.
Fiji go to France on 7 November, so the new caps get one Test to learn what White wants. Japan get one more go at something they last managed in 1994.
